mapper.select: SELECT token_hist_idx, user_idx, hist_type, amount, balance_after, created_at FROM token_history WHERE user_idx = #{user_idx} and hist_type='채팅 신청' or hist_type='매칭 신청' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT token_hist_idx, user_idx, hist_type, amount, balance_after, created_at FROM token_history WHERE user_idx = #{user_idx} and hist_type='충전' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO token_history ( token_hist_idx, user_idx, hist_type, amount, balance_after, created_at ) VALUES ( SEQ_TOKEN_HISTORY.NEXTVAL, #{user_idx}, #{hist_type}, #{amount}, #{balance_after}, SYSDATE )
